changelog: [When to Segment]: Clarified the internal-punctuation split rule to explicitly cover short rhetorical noun-phrase questions (e.g. bare NP + '?') followed by a clause that introduces its own new subject/predicate — this recovers measured under-segmentation cases where a '?' boundary was skipped, while staying consistent with (not contradicting) the existing Never-Segment condition that still blocks splitting when the following words merely keep specifying the same NP.

[Examples — Segment]: Added a worked example showing the bare-NP + '?' + new-clause split now explicitly licensed by the clarified rule, and removed the '그니까...그러니까' example (redundant with two other -거든/-니까 examples already present) to stay within the 12-example cap while keeping the set non-redundant.
